shorts.title: Shoebills Raise One Chick and Keep the Other as a Spare
shorts.outro: Doug hatches into that nest as the spare in the full video below.
shorts.description: Shoebill pairs almost always raise only one chick, the second is kept as an insurance policy, and the parents let siblicide happen; Doug hatches into that nest as the spare in the full episode.

shorts.title: Shoebills Eat Baby Crocodiles Lighter Than a Bar of Soap
shorts.outro: Doug's other six deaths are in the full video below.
shorts.description: A Nile crocodile hatches at about 28 cm and 80 grams, which is exactly the kind of long thing a shoebill waits all day for; Doug's other six deaths are in the full episode.

shorts.title: Shoebills Cool Their Eggs With Bills Full of Swamp Water
shorts.outro: Doug's seven deaths are in the full shoebill video below.
shorts.description: On hot days shoebill parents carry water in their bills and pour it over both eggs, though they will almost always raise only one; the rest of the story is in the full episode.
